title: His trip to Europe
summary: He stayed four weeks and missed England.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: And you mentioned before that you had not done a lot of travel over the years. Is that something that you would like to do more of now?
I wouldn't mind it now. (inaudible). I like, I enjoyed that. I would like to do that.

I went to, even I'd, I was on my way, I had to come back here. I had the opportunity to go from there to England. But, I was there a month, and I'd been too long. I was there all of July. See, and the summertime is
their largest part of the season here. So, I had to turn around and come back.
So first, I went over there and I told Joe I would be able to stay for 2 weeks. But, when I got there, I stayed for 4 and then I had to come back. I didn't get the chance to go to England.
